About Gramian 
 Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.
 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking Multilingual Coding Experts to support AI training and evaluation projects by reviewing code, solving programming challenges, and improving the accuracy and clarity of AI-generated technical responses. You will combine hands-on programming skills with strong language proficiency to assess code quality, identify technical errors, and create clear coding prompts, solutions, and explanations in your language of expertise. Candidates may apply for one or more languages; proficiency in every listed language is not required.
 Languages in demand: English, Russian, Spanish, French, Chinese, Portuguese, Persian, Arabic, German, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Polish, Italian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Korean, Turkish, Norwegian, Estonian, and Romanian.
 
 SENIORITY: Junior to Experienced
 LANGUAGE: Strong proficiency in at least one target language and working proficiency in English
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Write, review, debug, and optimize code across a variety of programming tasks.

 Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and adherence to instructions.

 Create and review coding prompts, reference solutions, and technical explanations in your language of expertise.

 Ensure technical responses are linguistically accurate, clear, and use appropriate programming terminology.

 Identify coding errors, flawed reasoning, and inefficient implementations.

 Provide structured, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated technical responses.

 Follow project guidelines and maintain consistent quality and delivery standards. 
 Requirements 
 Strong written and verbal proficiency in at least one of the target languages.

 Working proficiency in English to understand technical instructions and communicate with the project team.

 Hands-on coding experience in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#.

 Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, debugging, and software development fundamentals.

 Ability to explain technical concepts clearly in your language of expertise.

 Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.
